summary: HSPnetPager is a custom ASP.NET WebControl for paging large datasets within HSPnet applications. It offers robust and customizable paging features including rendering of page navigation elements, management of page indices, and toggling between 'Show All' and paged views. The control also integrates with postback and event handling, and provides utilities for controlling captions and calculating rows displayed per page.
purpose: To provide a reusable, configurable pager for lists and tables in the HSPnet web application, enabling users to navigate large datasets efficiently.

fields.name: ItemCount
fields.description: Total number of items to paginate.

fields.name: PageCount
fields.description: Total number of pages calculated from ItemCount and PageSize.

fields.name: StartRow
fields.description: Starting row index for the current page.

workflows.name: Paging Workflow
steps: Calculate PageCount based on ItemCount and PageSize.
Render pager UI including previous/next buttons, numeric page links, and ellipsis as needed.
Handle link/button clicks via postback; update CurrentIndex accordingly.
Toggle between Show All and paged modes via TogglePaging method.
Update UI captions and visibility via TogglePagingCaption.
Determine number of rows displayed and calculate StartRow for the current page.

business_rules: Show All mode sets PageSize to a maximum value so that paging is bypassed.
TogglePagingCaption hides or shows link/button captions based on the dataset size.
Numeric page links are shown for the current range, with ellipsis for jumps.
Previous/Next buttons are enabled or disabled depending on CurrentIndex.
validations: CurrentIndex must be within the PageCount range.
PageSize must be a positive integer.
ItemCount must be a non-negative number.
calculations: RowsDisplayed = min(PageSize, ItemCount - StartRow) for the last page.
conditions: If ItemCount < defaultPageSize, Hide paging toggle.
If CurrentIndex == PageCount, Next button disabled.
If PageSize >= maxPageSize, Show All mode enabled.
system_behavior: Renders a table-based pager UI for navigation.
Handles command events from paging links/buttons.
Supports saving and loading control state for persistence across postbacks.
Works with ASP.NET client script and server-side postbacks.
exceptions: Invalid page index or page size will result in incorrect paging behavior.
If Page is null, Render may fail.
Conversion errors on indices (e.g., string to int) in postback handling.
content_gaps: No explicit runtime error handling documented.
UI/UX details (styling, accessibility, localization) are referenced but not fully described.
